notes: Place names no longer overlap: a name that would cover another one is hidden until you zoom in (the most useful places, like clinics and gas stations, keep their names first)
New: Google Maps as a map provider (road, dark, satellite, satellite + roads, terrain). Your key stays on the map server, like the Azure key
With Google Maps, Places now come from Google, so businesses Google's map pictures leave out (stores, gas stations, doctors) show up too
Google places have a daily limit (Settings → Map, 150 by default) so you stay inside Google's free amount
Needs two APIs on your Google key: Map Tiles API and Places API (New) (see the README)
New check for Google Maps problems: python3 /opt/dji-flightmap/app/server.py --check-google
